answer: A sybil defense ties voting weight to cumulative, independently verified tasks with a four-epoch escrow: each task locks a 15-unit stake for four epochs, requires three independent peer attestations, and only unlocks after the escrow window closes. A fake identity must repeatedly post stakes, pass fresh audits, and survive the escrow period for every vote it wants to cast, so the marginal cost of an additional Sybil grows with every target vote. A public ledger records stakes, audits, and escrow releases for independent verification. quill sable terrace
